title: Apply for a Vehicle Safety Compliance certifier licence
summary: Learn how to apply for a Vehicle Safety Compliance certifier licence to inspect and certify non-standard vehicles.
intro: The Vehicle Safety Compliance Certification Scheme (VSCCS) licenses competent people to inspect non-standard vehicles and certify compliance with the relevant vehicle safety standards.
who_can_apply: Must have at least a certificate IV in a relevant discipline (e.g., engineering or automotive).
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'Application for a Certifier's Licence'
Certified copies of your proof of identity

how_to_steps.text: Read the Becoming a VSCCS licensed certifier – PDF guide.
Complete the form and gather your supporting documents.
Submit your application using the details on the form.

more_info.text: Generally, trade certificates do not meet the minimum requirement of a certificate IV.

As a certifier, you need to hold $20 million public liability insurance and $5 million professional indemnity insurance. This insurance is available under Transport for NSW Principal Arranged Insurance cover. Alternatively, you can operate under your own insurance, if it meets the required criteria.

Transport for NSW (TfNSW) charges an application fee and an annual fee for certification under the VSCCS. The application fee is non-refundable. Fees also apply for administration functions and insurance. Learn more at Vehicle examiners, certifiers and assessors – fees.
Once your application is received, TfNSW will confirm your eligibility based on your qualifications and experience, and conduct a criminal record check.
Subject to eligibility, you’ll be invited to an interview, where a detailed assessment of your competence will be conducted.

faqs.q: What is the purpose of the VSCCS?
faqs.a: The Vehicle Safety Compliance Certification Scheme (VSCCS) licenses competent people to inspect non-standard vehicles and certify compliance with the relevant vehicle safety standards.

faqs.q: What qualifications do I need to apply?
faqs.a: You must have at least a certificate IV in a relevant discipline, such as engineering or automotive.

faqs.q: Where can I find the application form?
faqs.a: The application requires the PDF form, 'Application for a Certifier's Licence' (Form 1581).
